title: Requirements traceability: every brief requirement -> status -> evidence

statuses.partial: implemented but limited by a documented evidence gap
statuses.blocked: cannot be completed from official sources; blank + flagged

rows.requirement: Price-snapshot store recording opening and closing numbers for every market we originate
rows.evidence: data/price_snapshots.json (39 snapshots: 13 games x side/total/moneyline, open+close+drift); page pages/price-snapshots.html

rows.requirement: Verified results feed so backtests and ROI can be computed
rows.evidence: data/results_feed.json: 137 settled games, 32 re-read line-by-line from official pages this session, 160/160 standings cells match, league identities pass (V-01..V-03)

rows.requirement: Originate the side first, then the total, then the moneyline
rows.evidence: engine/originate.py computes and writes markets in fixed order [side, total, moneyline]; order recorded per row and audited (own_lines_*.json origination_order)

rows.requirement: Publish the model's fair line, the market line, and the difference as separate columns
rows.evidence: All three columns exist per market on pages/own-lines.html; fair values are populated; market and difference columns are blank because no official price source exists (FB-01) — blanks are flagged, never inferred

rows.requirement: Separate signal from staking in the leaderboard so lucky staking cannot mask bad signal
rows.evidence: data/leaderboard.json: ranking key = signal tier first; staking columns cannot promote a non-A strategy; points additionally require verified prices (amendment A1) so 0 points are paid on assumed prices

rows.requirement: Track the depth of the replacement, not just the fact of a replacement
rows.evidence: data/depth_replacements.json: depth strings published ONLY where official text states them (SEA QB: 1st/2nd backup proven); MIA/MIN depth blank + flagged; no depth inferred from third-party charts

rows.requirement: Compute correlations only from officially sourced numbers and publish n with each value
rows.evidence: data/correlations.json: 5 computed (CR-01..CR-05) from official scores only, each with n, r, p, 95% CI; 4 requested-but-unsourced correlations published blank with reasons (CR-06..CR-09)

rows.requirement: Define a demotion gate that sends a live strategy back to paper
rows.evidence: data/gates.json demotion_gate D1 (four firing conditions, auto-demote, re-promotion requires fresh gates); evaluation recorded in data/demotion_eval.json; no strategy currently LIVE

rows.requirement: Dedicated suggestions section for review before implementation
rows.evidence: data/suggestions.json (13 proposals, options A/B/C, recommendation, status=proposed); pages/suggestions.html; nothing implemented without a reviewer choosing a path

rows.requirement: Clear list of questions / information / answers needed before any decision
rows.evidence: data/questions.json (15 questions: known/unknown/answer/discovery action); pages/questions.html; unknown answers left blank by design

rows.requirement: Strategies as a leaderboard competition with rewards for top performers (singles, parlays, prop combos)
rows.evidence: Registry has singles S1-S3, parlay S4, prop combo S5 (blocked, FB-05); 1,000-point reward rule defined; 0 points payable because no strategy passes G7-verified pricing (amendment A1) and S2-S4 fail gates

rows.requirement: Validation gates + luck removal (selectively skill-based strategies)
rows.evidence: data/gates.json G1-G8 pre-committed before backtest (git f4465c0); backtest runs 500 placebos (G4) and a leakage test (G3, pass); outcomes in data/backtest.json

rows.requirement: Track injuries and offensive/defensive deficiencies incl. 2nd/3rd/4th-string replacements
rows.evidence: data/injuries_week10_capture.json (official report chunks 0-1, 107 rows) + data/depth_replacements.json; full 8-chunk report and depth charts beyond official text not captured (FB-06, FB-07)

rows.requirement: GitHub Pages site: clean dashboard, category subpages, tables with a source link on every row, Flagged for Review
rows.evidence: nfl-book/ static site, 16 pages; engine/verify.py enforces a source link on every table row and resolves every internal link

rows.requirement: No manual input; verify line by line; no hallucinations; unverifiable values blank + flagged
rows.evidence: All work automated this session; 32 games + 32 standings rows read line by line; every unverifiable cell published blank with an unverified marker and a flag ID
